_about: EADS-CASA, CN-235-300 Technical Review (2002), page 4: the plan view, an embedded 604 x 718 px picture drawn nose left, extracted as it is (plan_raw.png) and rendered with layers.py --mode lines --contrast 25 at scale 4 with --xscale 0.98673: the plan is drawn 1.3% long against the side view (its nose-to-tail 1808.5 px at this scale against the side's 1784.5), evened out lengthwise; across, at the side's scale (its tips 25.83 m apart against the printed 25.81 m). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half. The radome's black fill: the nose tip placed (free). The main gear's sponson and the wing's root fairing hide the fuselage's side under the wing (bridged). The wing's and tailplane's leading edges are drawn as thick black de-icing boots: their outer edges are placed (free points, 2 px inside the ink's edge); the root's inboard leading edge, ahead of the nacelle, is a plain line. The nacelle's sides from the spinner's tip to the wing's leading edge.
